newsitem.title: JAPAN: INSTANT VIEW -Japan Jan customs-cleared trade data.
newsitem.headline: INSTANT VIEW -Japan Jan customs-cleared trade data.

text.p: The following are initial reactions from analysts to Japan"s January customs-cleared trade data. The Finance Ministry said the surplus fell 91.7 percent in January year-on-year to 5.19 billion yen.
PETER MORGAN, CHIEF ECONOMIST, JAMES CAPEL PACIFIC:

"If you look at the seasonally adjusted figures, it"s pretty clear that the bottom was around last May, so it has been gradually trending up. It"s really a question of at what point you will see a year-on-year rise, certainly by the second quarter."
